fault actions (faults: [{atMs, action, args}]):
  partition {"groups":[["n1","n2"],["n3","n4","n5"]]}: split the network into groups; messages between groups are dropped, including in-flight ones
  isolate {"node":"n1"}: cut one node off from all others
  heal {}: remove every partition
  crash {"node":"n1"}: crash a node: volatile state is lost, whatever it persisted to disk survives
  restart {"node":"n1"}: restart a crashed node from its disk
  pause {"node":"n1","durationMs":400}: freeze a node (GC-style): it processes nothing, messages queue and timers fire late, then it resumes
  setNetwork {"minLatencyMs":1,"maxLatencyMs":80,"dropRate":0.1,"duplicateRate":0.05}: change the network model from this time on; every field is optional
workload: each client process has at most one outstanding op; ops are reads and writes on keys x, y, z, ...; write values are unique per key. Clients follow leader hints and retry. An op that times out is indeterminate (status info) and its process retires; status fail means the op definitely did not take effect.
checker: per-key linearizability of the recorded history; verdict ok, violation or unknown (checker timeout).
